comparison.objective: Candidate configures a gripper stop; this record sharpens both faces of a kitchen knife on a whetstone.
comparison.physical_skill: Candidate applies controlled countertorque through two tools; the record maintains blade angle and edge-leading contact across heel-to-tip strokes on both faces.
comparison.success_condition: Candidate checks retained opening cycles; the record checks measured sharpness or simulated edge coverage, safe placement, release, and stillness.
comparison.reason: Angle appears in both rubrics, but the record tests sustained abrasive contact orientation and edge coverage, not setting or locking an angle.
